id.description: Academic morph code, the primary id. SBL-style consonantal transliteration of the lemma (e.g. qol, qara, YHWH). Not a Strong's number.

form.description: Consonantal Unicode lemma in Hebrew or Aramaic script.

pos.description: Morphological class of the lemma (noun, verb, particle, adverb, properNoun...).

gloss.description: One-line gloss. Public-domain dictionaries only (BDB 1906 for Hebrew, Jastrow 1903 for Aramaic).

strongs.description: Optional Strong's code(s) as metadata for joins to public-domain lexicons (Strong 1890). The academic morph code in id is the primary key, never Strong's.
